tool_args.rationale: The specified barrier model and the square-root two-layer siphon both failed fresh confirmation decisively. The rows vary broadly in s_grad, so another broad-span measurement is not the priority; the remaining credible siphon alternatives differ in the local branch form/sign. Acquire the targeted open-branch probe before fitting a revised model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the two-layer siphon with a linear leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The current five-row set can support parameter estimation, but the square-root branch model already failed fresh confirmation substantially; one discriminating observation is more informative before choosing a branch.

All existing rows have the same horizon and fixed state/memory, but no evidence specifically points to a coupled temporal ODE; the cheaper open-branch probe better targets the unresolved branch ambiguity.
Two stationary candidate fits have failed, but this is not evidence of non-stationary oscillations or that all smooth mechanisms are refuted.
